_doc: Reference rule-processor config for the agent-lesson gated lifecycle (ADR-080 / agent-memory-lesson-substrate). The primary promotion/retirement path is the operator/product-invoked LessonCurator writer in processor/agentic-tools/lesson_promotion.go (Promote — evidence-existence-gated proposed->active; Retire; Supersede). This config declares the local lesson lifecycle reconcile group (agent.lesson.status / .superseded-by / .retired-at) and one example reconcile_predicates rule showing the mechanical primitive a product wires to its own trigger. The example is a birth-time suppression policy: it flips a freshly-born proposed lesson's status straight to retired; it does not retire an already-active lesson and does not mutate category (category is identity-bearing — the rule only reads it as a condition). See README.md for both lanes. The projection_contracts block must mirror lessonRecordProjectionContract() in cmd/semstreams/main.go and cmd/e2e-semstreams/main.go; birth predicates are deliberately absent from the reconcile group.

inline_rules.name: Auto-retire suppressed lessons at birth
inline_rules.description: Birth-time suppression primitive using reconcile_predicates. An ops persona may tag lessons that document an already-fixed anti-pattern with the open category 'deprecated'. When such a lesson is born proposed, this rule reconciles agent.lesson.status to retired. It does not retire an already-active lesson, mutate category, or perform the evidence checks required for promotion; those remain the responsibility of LessonCurator. The written predicate must be a literal member of this pack's local reconcile group.
